extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: compact street sweeper (approx. 2 m3 hopper), approx. 4.5 x 1.9 x 2.2 m (L x W x H incl. brushes and mirrors), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the two disc brushes 'street-sweeper_brush_l' and 'street-sweeper_brush_r' are separate objects with their origin on the vertical brush axis at ground level (rotate around local Z to sweep, in opposite directions); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); two amber beacons glow softly; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
